prompt: Make ONLY a targeted wardrobe correction to this gouache character reference sheet. Preserve exactly the SAME Luna facial identity, hairstyle, charcoal t-shirt, panel composition, expression, anatomy and lovely hand-painted gouache medium. In BOTH front and back full-body panels replace the camouflage-looking patterns on the trousers with PLAIN SOLID UNIFORM OLIVE cotton cargo trousers, one dyed fabric color approximately #737754 across the entire garment. No mottled patches, no camouflage shapes, no two-tone pattern, no decorative color blocks. Show fabric volume with only subtle gradual light/shadow and thin fold contours, not separate colored paint islands. Keep side cargo pockets and original loose silhouette. Both feet wear BLACK HIGH-TOP canvas Converse: lift trouser hems just enough to reveal the high ankle collars, off-white toe caps and cream laces, flat soles, ankle badge ONLY on inner side. No exterior ankle logos. Keep every other pixel/compositional element as close as possible. No new marks, no text, no extra panels or props.
sourcePrompt: Create a professional CHARACTER CONTINUITY SHEET in hand-painted WATERCOLOR AND OPAQUE GOUACHE on warm ivory textured paper. REFERENCE1 is the sole exact identity and wardrobe reference: the SAME fictional 15-year-old Luna, preserve youthful face shape, brown eyes, nose, eyebrows, warm brown skin, dark curly LOW ponytail, ordinary teenage proportions. REFERENCE2 guides PAINT MEDIUM ONLY: translucent washes, broad opaque brush shapes, subtle dry edges and reserved paper; not photorealism, not 3D, not glossy anime. Three clearly separated equal panels on one landscape16:9 sheet: LEFT full head-to-toe FRONT standing view, CENTER full head-to-toe BACK standing view, RIGHT enlarged head-and-shoulders THREE-QUARTER portrait. Both full figures have margin above head and below feet. Charcoal oversized plain cotton T-shirt, plain solid olive baggy cargo trousers NOT camouflage, exact same garment colors/fit across panels; black classic canvas high-top sneakers with ivory toes and cream laces, inner-ankle badges only. Neutral relaxed posture, hands empty, restrained curious expression, no glamour or makeup or adult proportions. Plain warm paper backdrop in every panel, no attic, no props, no captions or labels or dates, no logos overlaid as graphics, no tattoos or invented facial marks. Depict one identity consistently, detailed face while keeping confident visible painted planes.

qa.fr: Visage et proportions proches de L01 ; matière gouache nette. Les cols montants sont désormais visibles. Les ombres du cargo restent très contrastées et peuvent évoquer un motif : à simplifier sur la référence finale.
qa.en: Face and proportions remain close to L01; clear gouache planes. High-top collars are now visible. Cargo shadows remain strongly contrasted and can read as a pattern; simplify them on the final master.
